{{Quote|Attack! Enemies ahead and to the rear!|Dresdema, ordering the Nightsisters to attack the Sith|<ref name="Back" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place in a [[Dathomir landing meadow|landing meadow]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], the sole survivor of a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] that had [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], fled to Dathomir and sent a [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] message to her [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] to retrieve her. On Dathomir, Khai encountered a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and, realizing their [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] potential, arranged for their capture by her Tribe. A convoy of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]] arrived [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] to pick up the Nightsisters, who attacked when they discovered that the Sith included [[Gender/Legends|men]]. The Sith easily defeated the Nightsisters, capturing them and [[Death/Legends|killing]] their [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]].

==Prelude==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]&mdash;the sole survivor of a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] that had [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|battled]] with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]&mdash;made her way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where she sent a [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] message to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Order]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], so they could retrieve her. On Dathomir, she came into contact with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-wielding [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. She convinced them that they should team up with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] so the factions could share the knowledge of their [[Force power/Legends|powers]] with each other; however, Khai simply intended for them to become Sith.<ref name="Back" />

==The skirmish==
When a group of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] arrived on Dathomir under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]], Khai ordered for the Nightsisters to convene in a [[Dathomir landing meadow|meadow]]. Approximately 24 Nightsisters arrived with at least 18 [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] to await the Sith's arrival. When Gaalan landed and revealed his presence, however, the Nightsisters felt betrayed&mdash;in their culture, [[Gender/Legends|women]] were superior to men, and the idea of being in league with a man disgusted them. Their leader, [[Dresdema]] called for them to attack, but they were outflanked by 7 more Sith. Their powers proved to be no match for the Sith, who quickly killed the rancors and incapacitated the Nightsisters, loading them into a shuttle and taking them to meet up with the larger [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Dathomir. Although many of the Nightsisters still resisted, the Sith planned to break their will and turn them into Sith.<ref name="Back" />

==Aftermath==
Back on Dathomir, the Skywalkers&mdash;who had tracked Khai and found her living among the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]&mdash;along with their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] friend [[Dyon Stadd]], arrived on the scene and [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|confronted]] Gaalan and two [[Sith Saber]]s who had remained behind to retrieve Khai, defeating them and capturing the apprentice.<ref name="Back" /> They were confronted by the Sith fleet in orbit, however, and coerced into an alliance with the Sith for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to eliminate the dark side entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

During the battle with Abeloth, the Sith used a technique that they had learned from the captured Nightsisters, the [[control web]], to attempt to capture Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish first appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, written by [[Aaron Allston]].
